## Tutorials

The SUBSTRING_INDEX() function returns a substring of a string before a 
specified number of 
delimiter occurs.

### Code Examples

```
SELECT SUBSTRING_INDEX("www.w3schools.com", ".", 1);

---

SUBSTRING_INDEX(
string
,
delimiter
,
number
)

---

SELECT SUBSTRING_INDEX("www.w3schools.com", ".", 2);
```

## Tutorials

The TRIM() function removes leading and trailing spaces from a string.

### Code Examples

```
SELECT TRIM('    SQL Tutorial    ') AS TrimmedString;

---

TRIM(
string
)
```

## Tutorials

The UCASE() function converts a string to upper-case.

Note:This function is equal to theUPPER()function.

### Code Examples

```
SELECT UCASE("SQL Tutorial is FUN!");

---

UCASE(
text
)

---

SELECT UCASE(CustomerName) AS UppercaseCustomerName
FROM Customers;
```

## Tutorials

The UPPER() function converts a string to upper-case.

Note:This function is equal to theUCASE()function.

### Code Examples

```
SELECT UPPER("SQL Tutorial is FUN!");

---

UPPER(
text
)

---

SELECT UPPER(CustomerName) AS UppercaseCustomerName
FROM Customers;
```

## Tutorials

The ABS() function returns the absolute (positive) value of a number.

### Code Examples

```
SELECT ABS(-243.5);

---

ABS(
number
)
```
